acceptanceCriteria: The immutable W314 delivery remains unchanged: its Contract, Summary, Outcome, Events, archive, verification, recovery, finalization, and close bytes are not rewritten or regenerated.

The closed-Work-Item promotion gate skips a predecessor only when a valid successor or supersede recovery decision is repository-bound, even when that predecessor also has a confirmed approved close; retry recovery remains a normal terminal candidate.
A regression fixture covers a confirmed approved close plus a valid successor recovery, and invalid, foreign, malformed, or retry recovery decisions are not treated as promotion exceptions.

Tri-language Work Item and reference-parity documentation register W315 before verification, describe the W314 immutable predecessor and hosted failure, and make no undocumented green or terminal claim.
Focused documentation regressions, cargo fmt, clippy with warnings denied, the full locked workspace test suite, and hosted CI pass from this exact branch and base.
